orientations.intent: Look up the archive-4 record in an external provenance service

final_message:
Based on my inspection of the tools available (repo, tests, git, episodes handles), none of them provide access to an external provenance service. The repo handle only exposes internal repository operations (e.g., `status` showing branch/clean state), and there is no verb or capability related to querying external provenance services or archive records like "archive-4."

**Answer: No.** The available tools cannot look up the "archive-4" record in an external provenance service — no such capability exists among the reachable verbs on any of the provided handles.
